segments.summary: Account propagation, scaling, advanced-view state, panel-state boundaries, command palette, and Search ownership were reviewed.
Breadcrumbs, shortcut registration/platform behavior, detachable terminal identity, runtime IA, and terminal split embedding were reviewed.
Terminal drag/motion plus panel docking, snap, shared-model, discoverability, and persistence contracts were reviewed.
Panel recovery and the built-in theme, token, generated-effect, overlay, switching, and Slint-global contracts were reviewed.
Runtime theme application, custom theme/font loading and management, terminal themes, and WCAG boundaries were reviewed.
View ownership, Orchestrator projection and Progress composition, legacy aliases, surface ownership, attention routing, and Seams actions were reviewed.
Shared status, deep-link context, state explanation, dense accessibility, blocked recovery, policy receipts, and Progress catalog routing were reviewed.
Progress labels/events, shared route payloads, object-first pivots, compatibility identity, open primitives, and concern routes were reviewed.
